options.content:
### Existing telemetry - six machines - one isolated viewing layer
**rg-hyperv-arc-monitor-demo** - the primary region host/guests; SQL Arc + Change Tracking inventory in Southeast Asia. **Read-only:** no guest commands, SQL connections, simulations, agents, DCRs, network, maintenance, alert edits or new collection. This is a demonstration lab, not an approved production architecture.

**Trust the evidence:** gaps are not zero; freshness uses interval end; inventory is asynchronous. Machine selection affects only panels marked SELECTED. Host-side and all-three-group panels retain fixed scope. The Windows group is logical, **not WSFC**. SQL cap is taken from data, not a painted 9,829-MiB target.

panels.title: Operations evidence & safety boundary

panels.description: Counts are derived from the six expected machine rows, not from an observed-only denominator. Freshness threshold is 5 minutes relative to interval end.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let expected=datatable(Computer:string)['HV-HOST-01','RHEL94-GUEST','SQL2019-GUEST','WIN2019-GUEST','WIN2022-GUEST','WIN2025-GUEST-01'];
let observed=Heartbeat
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Computer in~ ('HV-HOST-01','RHEL94-GUEST','SQL2019-GUEST','WIN2019-GUEST','WIN2022-GUEST','WIN2025-GUEST-01') and (isempty(tolower(tostring(column_ifexists('_ResourceId','')))) or tolower(tostring(column_ifexists('_ResourceId',''))) startswith '/subscriptions/<SUBSCRIPTION_ID>/resourcegroups/rg-hyperv-arc-monitor-demo/')
| extend Computer=toupper(Computer),Ingested=ingestion_time()
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,OSType,Ingested),Samples=count() by Computer
| project Computer,LastSeen=TimeGenerated,Samples,OSType,LastIngested=Ingested;
expected | join kind=leftouter observed on Computer
| extend Samples=coalesce(Samples,0),AgeMinutes=round(datetime_diff('second',$__timeTo(),LastSeen)/60.0,1),IngestionLagSeconds=datetime_diff('second',LastIngested,LastSeen)
| extend Reporting=case(isnull(LastSeen),'MISSING',AgeMinutes>5,'STALE','FRESH')
| project Computer,Reporting,LastSeen,AgeMinutes,Samples,OSType,IngestionLagSeconds
| order by Computer asc
| summarize Fresh=countif(Reporting=='FRESH'),Stale=countif(Reporting=='STALE'),Missing=countif(Reporting=='MISSING'),Expected=count()

azureLogAnalytics.query:
Perf
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Computer in~ ('WIN2019-GUEST','WIN2022-GUEST','WIN2025-GUEST-01') and (isempty(tolower(tostring(column_ifexists('_ResourceId','')))) or tolower(tostring(column_ifexists('_ResourceId',''))) startswith '/subscriptions/<SUBSCRIPTION_ID>/resourcegroups/rg-hyperv-arc-monitor-demo/')
| where (ObjectName=='Processor Information' and CounterName=='% Processor Time' and InstanceName=='_Total')
    or (ObjectName=='Memory' and CounterName=='Available Bytes')
| summarize MeanCPU=avgif(CounterValue,CounterName=='% Processor Time'),
    MeanAvailableBytes=avgif(CounterValue,CounterName=='Available Bytes'),
    CPURecords=countif(CounterName=='% Processor Time'),
    MemoryRecords=countif(CounterName=='Available Bytes'),Latest=max(TimeGenerated) by Computer
| extend PhysicalUsedPercent=100.0*(1-MeanAvailableBytes/8589934592.0),
    BaselineVCPU=4,BaselineRAMGiB=8
| project Computer,MeanCPU,PhysicalUsedPercent,BaselineVCPU,BaselineRAMGiB,CPURecords,MemoryRecords,Latest
| join kind=rightouter (datatable(ExpectedMember:string)[
'WIN2019-GUEST','WIN2022-GUEST','WIN2025-GUEST-01']) on $left.Computer==$right.ExpectedMember
| project Member=ExpectedMember,MeanCPU,PhysicalUsedPercent,
    BaselineVCPU=4,BaselineRAMGiB=8,CPURecords=coalesce(CPURecords,0),
    MemoryRecords=coalesce(MemoryRecords,0),Latest
| order by Member asc

options.content: Host disks, VHDXs, guest volumes and Linux mapper aliases are **not additive**. SQL data/log VHDXs share the same backing data disk; logical separation is not physical isolation. Quiet directions have null latency; the existing Hyper-V latency 1000 conversion is preserved.

panels.title: Storage accounting boundary

panels.description: Host physical, Hyper-V virtual, Windows logical and RHEL block-device views are separate accounting layers. Zero or missing operation counts yield null latency. RHEL latency is operation weighted. Windows/host latency is sampled counter average 1000, not operation weighted. VHDX conversion preserves workbook evidence.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
Perf
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Computer in~ ('HV-HOST-01','RHEL94-GUEST','SQL2019-GUEST','WIN2019-GUEST','WIN2022-GUEST','WIN2025-GUEST-01') and (isempty(tolower(tostring(column_ifexists('_ResourceId','')))) or tolower(tostring(column_ifexists('_ResourceId',''))) startswith '/subscriptions/<SUBSCRIPTION_ID>/resourcegroups/rg-hyperv-arc-monitor-demo/')
| where (Computer=='HV-HOST-01' and ObjectName in ('PhysicalDisk','Hyper-V Virtual Storage Device'))
    or (Computer!='HV-HOST-01' and ObjectName=='LogicalDisk')
| where InstanceName!='_Total'
| where ObjectName!='Hyper-V Virtual Storage Device' or InstanceName endswith '.vhdx'
| where CounterName in ('Disk Reads/sec','Disk Writes/sec','Disk Transfers/sec',
    'Avg. Disk sec/Read','Avg. Disk sec/Write','Avg. Disk sec/Transfer',
    'Read Operations/Sec','Write Operations/Sec','Latency')
| extend Layer=case(ObjectName=='PhysicalDisk','Host physical disk',
    ObjectName=='LogicalDisk','Windows guest volume','Hyper-V virtual disk')
| summarize ReadIOPS=avgif(CounterValue,CounterName in ('Disk Reads/sec','Read Operations/Sec')),
    WriteIOPS=avgif(CounterValue,CounterName in ('Disk Writes/sec','Write Operations/Sec')),
    TransferIOPS=avgif(CounterValue,CounterName=='Disk Transfers/sec'),
    ReadSeconds=avgif(CounterValue,CounterName=='Avg. Disk sec/Read'),
    WriteSeconds=avgif(CounterValue,CounterName=='Avg. Disk sec/Write'),
    TransferSeconds=avgif(CounterValue,CounterName in ('Avg. Disk sec/Transfer','Latency')),
    Latest=max(TimeGenerated),Samples=count() by Computer,Device=InstanceName,Layer
| extend TotalIOPS=iff(Layer=='Hyper-V virtual disk',ReadIOPS+WriteIOPS,TransferIOPS)
| project Computer,Layer,Device,ReadIOPS,WriteIOPS,TotalIOPS,
    ReadLatencyMs=iff(ReadIOPS>0 and isfinite(ReadSeconds),ReadSeconds*1000,real(null)),
    WriteLatencyMs=iff(WriteIOPS>0 and isfinite(WriteSeconds),WriteSeconds*1000,real(null)),
    TransferLatencyMs=iff(TotalIOPS>0 and isfinite(TransferSeconds),TransferSeconds*1000,real(null)),Latest,Samples
| union (
HvLinuxDisk_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Computer in~ ('RHEL94-GUEST') and (isempty(tolower(tostring(column_ifexists('_ResourceId','')))) or tolower(tostring(column_ifexists('_ResourceId',''))) startswith '/subscriptions/<SUBSCRIPTION_ID>/resourcegroups/rg-hyperv-arc-monitor-demo/')
| where AccountingScope=='block-device'
| extend RO=ReadIOPS*IntervalSeconds,WO=WriteIOPS*IntervalSeconds
| summarize ReadIOPS=avg(ReadIOPS),WriteIOPS=avg(WriteIOPS),
    RO=sum(RO),WO=sum(WO),RW=sum(ReadAwaitMs*RO),WW=sum(WriteAwaitMs*WO),
    Latest=max(TimeGenerated),Samples=count() by Computer,Device
| project Computer,Layer='RHEL block device (aliases not additive)',Device,
    ReadIOPS,WriteIOPS,TotalIOPS=ReadIOPS+WriteIOPS,
    ReadLatencyMs=iff(RO>0,RW/RO,real(null)),
    WriteLatencyMs=iff(WO>0,WW/WO,real(null)),
    TransferLatencyMs=real(null),Latest,Samples)
| order by Layer asc,Computer asc,Device asc

| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)

    ObservedMembers=dcount(Computer),DistinctVolumes=count() by TimeGenerated
